name: Nicolaus Grabowski

events.place: Olesko, Bezirk Olesko, Kreis Złoczów, Verwaltungsgebiet Lemberg, Kingdom of Galicia and Lodomeria, Austrian Empire

notes: Family History Centre: The death record for Nicolaus Grabowski is found on copy of LDS film # 2037644, page 60.  This record clearly shows the parents to be Nicolai Grabowski and Annae Hryniewicz.  It shows the death date as Sept. 14, 1862 and that Nicolaus was a child of 2 years which puts his birth date at 1860.
